name: flashattn_contest_l1_092_gqa_qknorm
author: flash_attn
description: GLM-4.5-Air full GQA causal attention block (96/8 GQA): F.linear with biases for QKV, FlashInfer rmsnorm on Q/K, RoPE, FlashAttention 2 causal native GQA, F.linear for O.

sources.content:
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import flashinfer.norm as fn
from flash_attn import flash_attn_func

NQ = 96
NKV = 8
HD = 128
SCALING = HD ** -0.5


def _rotate_half(x):
    half = x.shape[-1] // 2
    return torch.cat((-x[..., half:], x[..., :half]), dim=-1)


@torch.no_grad()
def run(hidden_states, q_proj_weight, q_proj_bias, k_proj_weight, k_proj_bias,
        v_proj_weight, v_proj_bias, o_proj_weight,
        q_norm_weight, k_norm_weight, cos, sin, rms_norm_eps):
    b, s, h = hidden_states.shape

    q = F.linear(hidden_states, q_proj_weight, q_proj_bias).view(b, s, NQ, HD)
    k = F.linear(hidden_states, k_proj_weight, k_proj_bias).view(b, s, NKV, HD)
    v = F.linear(hidden_states, v_proj_weight, v_proj_bias).view(b, s, NKV, HD)

    q = fn.rmsnorm(q.reshape(-1, HD).contiguous(), q_norm_weight, rms_norm_eps).view(b, s, NQ, HD)
    k = fn.rmsnorm(k.reshape(-1, HD).contiguous(), k_norm_weight, rms_norm_eps).view(b, s, NKV, HD)

    # RoPE in (B, H, S, D) layout (reference convention), then back to (B, S, H, D) for FA2
    q_t = q.transpose(1, 2)
    k_t = k.transpose(1, 2)
    cos_e = cos.unsqueeze(1)
    sin_e = sin.unsqueeze(1)
    q_t = q_t * cos_e + _rotate_half(q_t) * sin_e
    k_t = k_t * cos_e + _rotate_half(k_t) * sin_e
    q = q_t.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()
    k = k_t.transpose(1, 2).contiguous()

    out = flash_attn_func(q, k, v, causal=True, softmax_scale=SCALING)
    out = out.reshape(b, s, NQ * HD)
    return F.linear(out, o_proj_weight)
